title: Pulseboard: Thursday quick dump - Console & Tooling sync
content:
Quick capture from today’s midday Pulseboard — informal notes, action items, and stray thoughts. Intention: lightweight sync for panel/UI rollouts, canary telemetry, and short-term mitigations. NOT final; will fold into the sprint notes tomorrow.

Attendees:
- Lena (note-taker)
- Marco
- Priya
- Evan
- occasional check-ins from SRE (A. Williams)

Agenda (short):
1) Recent canary behavior and a weird spike on /panel/render path
2) UI experiment status: compact mode A/B and fallback UX when telemetry is missing
3) Analytics gap: missing panel_render_complete event causing incorrect adoption metrics
4) Quick action items for next 72 hours

Notes / Observations:
- Canary spike: observed a surge at 09:12 UTC where the canary cohort’s error rate jumped from 0.4% -> 3.6% for ~7 minutes. Errors were 502s from the panel-render lambda; initial hypothesis: cold JIT path + larger-than-expected image payload (client-side preview). SRE says backend infra retries masked a wider surface area. Filed CNTRL-1982.

- UI experiment (compact-mode v2): front-end A/B shows lower engagement on mobile but statistically significant reduction in time-to-first-paint (p<0.05). However, layout-shift on Android WebView for specific device family — reported in device logs (see PR #784). We should pause ramp above 20% on mobile until fix.

- Fallback UX: Marco demoed a small fallback card for cases where the analytics payload is missing. Idea: show a neutral mini-skeleton and queue the render for re-attempt. UX approved as temporary; will ship behind feature flag.

- Analytics gap: Priya found that ~18% of panel impressions in the last 48h didn’t emit panel_render_complete due to a race when JS bundle loads asynchronously and early navigations cancel the handler. This skews daily adoption numbers and triggers false negative regressions in Optimize alerts. Short-term plan: backfill via server-side logs for last 7 days and add a buffered client-emission to avoid the race. Jira: ROLL-342.

- Observability: p50 render = 130ms, p95 = 720ms, p99 = 1.9s for panel-render path in canary. Compared to production baseline: p95 ~480ms. The p95 regression aligns with the 7-minute spike window. Need higher-resolution tail-sampling for WebView clients.

- Telemetry pipeline: data lag increased from ~3 min -> ~12 min during the spike. Investigating whether batch windowing in the aggregator was backpressured by the retry storm. Ops will add circuit-breaker to the aggregator (SRE).

Open Questions / To be discussed in follow-up:
- Do we increase canary ramp delay by default for UI experiments that alter client bundle size? (proposal: +10m for mobile-heavy changes)
- Longer-term: should panel_render_complete be enforced server-side as authoritative for adoption metrics, with client as supplement?
- Do we need a lightweight offline telemetry shim for WebView to avoid lost events on aggressive navigation?

Action items (owner — ETA):
- Marco: small fallback card + feature flag; open PR and request review — ETA 2027-10-08. (blocks: none major)
- Priya: backfill pipeline job to reconcile panel_render_complete for the last 7 days; write acceptance checks — ETA 2027-10-09. (linked: ROLL-342)
- Evan: create high-res tail-tracing dashboard focused on WebView clients; add sampling rule for 1% p99 traces — ETA 2027-10-10.
- Lena: patch rollout playbook note to recommend canary ramp time increase for bundle-size changes; capture proposal and circulate — ETA 2027-10-08.
- SRE (A. Williams): add circuit-breaker to telemetry aggregator and increase retry jitter; hotfix deploy if we reproduce — ETA 2027-10-08 (in collaboration with infra team).

Decisions made:
- Pause compact-mode A/B ramp on Android WebView above 20% until layout-shift fix confirmed.
- Ship fallback UX behind feature flag immediately to limit user-visible regressions.
- Run backfill reconciliation for analytics before we mark compact-mode as positive in Optimize.

Notes to self / miscellaneous fragments:
- "Remember to update the rollouts playbook with a checkbox: 'Does this change increase client bundle or critical path loading?'"
- Need to coordinate with product regarding comms: if adoption looks negative because of missing events, we want to avoid premature rollback. Priya will draft an internal note for product ops.
- Consider a small e2e test in CI that runs a minimal WebView harness to catch the race early.

Next sync: informal follow-up Friday 09:30 UTC (15 minutes) — focus on PR status and backfill verification. If any hotfix required, call the rollout channel and escalate to oncall.

Links / quick refs:
- CNTRL-1982 (canary spike investigation)
- ROLL-342 (analytics backfill)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/784
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/987654321

End of dump. If anything missing ping me in #console-rollouts or tag @lena.
